title: 上海国际艺术节的第25次亮相
subtitle: 从演出季到全球艺术网络

article.en: The 25th China Shanghai International Arts Festival opened on Saturday with a concert marking the debut of the Shanghai Grand Opera House, a new landmark by the Huangpu River. It runs until Nov 15 and offers nearly 400 performances and exhibitions, with about 1,100 events in the city. Its main program has 60 productions in 168 shows, and almost ninety percent are debuts here. The festival also builds lasting ties. The Network of Silk Road Arts Festivals, founded in 2017, now has 216 members from 53 countries and regions, and nearly 300 delegates met in Shanghai on Oct 17. Twenty-five Chinese productions traveled abroad through the network this year, taking Chinese opera, lion dance and piano music to other stages. It also launched a global training program, the CSIAF Academy, and signed more than ten cooperation agreements. Back in Shanghai, the city also set up a new performing arts group, bringing together 18 state-owned troupes and 25 theaters. The group plans to develop new scripts and send shows on tours abroad. Old and new art now meet here: the city has turned a festival into a bridge between Chinese culture and the world.
article.zh: 第25届中国上海国际艺术节于周六开幕，开幕音乐会同时是上海大剧院的首演——这座黄浦江畔的全新地标。艺术节将持续到11月15日，期间举办近400场演出和展览，全城各类活动约1100场。其中主单元共60部剧目、168场演出，近九成是上海首演。 艺术节也在积累长久联系。2017年成立的丝绸之路艺术节联盟如今已有来自53个国家和地区的216家成员，10月17日近300名代表在上海聚会。今年有25部中国作品通过该平台走向海外，把京剧、舞狮和钢琴音乐带到别的舞台；联盟还启动了全球培训项目——CSIAF 学院，并签署了十余项合作协定。 在上海本地，城里还成立了新的演艺集团，把18家国有剧团和25家剧场整合到一起，计划开发新剧本、把剧目送到海外巡演。新旧艺术在这里相遇：这座城市把一个艺术节变成了中国与世界之间的桥梁。

vocab.ex: The concert marked the debut of the new opera house.
vocab.note: make one's debut 首次亮相；debut 是四级阅读高频词

vocab.ex: The opera house is a new landmark by the river.
vocab.note: 既指地标建筑，也指里程碑事件：a landmark decision

vocab.ex: Nearly 400 performances and exhibitions will be held.
vocab.note: hold an exhibition；展览品用 exhibit（可数）

vocab.ex: The main program has 60 productions in 168 shows.
vocab.note: 文艺语境指「剧目/作品」；也可指 production cost（生产成本）

vocab.ex: The Network of Silk Road Arts Festivals has 216 members.
vocab.note: 此处是成员组成的「联盟」；join a network 加入网络

vocab.ex: Nearly 300 delegates met in Shanghai on Oct 17.
vocab.note: 会议代表用 delegate；不要与 delegate（委派）混淆

vocab.ex: The group brings together 18 state-owned troupes.
vocab.note: 同类还有 chorus（合唱团）、company（剧团）

vocab.ex: The group plans to develop new scripts.
vocab.note: read/write a script；四级作文写「剧本」用它

vocab.ex: The CSIAF Academy offers global training.
vocab.note: 常大写并与专名连用，如 Chinese Academy of Sciences

vocab.ex: More than ten cooperation agreements were signed.
vocab.note: cooperate (v.) 合作；in cooperation with 与……合作
put on a performance 演出；形容词 performed

vocab.ex: The 25th arts festival opened on Saturday.
vocab.note: the 25th festival；艺术节前常用专名修饰

translation.title: 国际文化交流：艺术节与全球网络
translation.brief: 下面五句围绕「国际文化交流」话题，按「事实数字—平台发展—成果—措施—展望」展开。注意数字改写与专有名词的处理。

sentences.cn: 今年是第25届中国上海国际艺术节，期间将举办近400场演出和展览，全城活动超过1100场。
sentences.ref: This year marks the 25th China Shanghai International Arts Festival, during which nearly 400 performances and exhibitions will be held, with more than 1,100 events taking place across the city.

hints.struct: This year marks + 专有名词 + 介词短语 + 主句

pts.t: 第25届 用序数词 the 25th；中文「届」不能用 times 之类。
中国上海国际艺术节 是专有名词，China Shanghai International Arts Festival 各词首字母大写，不要漏译成 generic art festival。
近400场 用 nearly 400；「近……场」不能写成 about 400 performances（about 只是「大约」）。
全城活动 用 events taking place across the city；across the city 是「全城」的自然表达。

sentences.cn: 丝绸之路艺术节联盟自2017年成立以来不断发展，如今已拥有来自53个国家和地区的216家成员机构。
sentences.ref: Since its founding in 2017, the Network of Silk Road Arts Festivals has kept growing and now has 216 member institutions from 53 countries and regions.

hints.struct: Since + 主语 + 现在完成时 + and now has

pts.t: 自……以来 用 Since its founding in 2017；since + 过去时间点，主句必须用现在完成时 has kept growing。
不断发展 用 kept growing；keep doing 表示持续，符合「不断」的语感。
216家成员机构 用 216 member institutions；机构用 institution，不要写成 member countries。
来自53个国家和地区 用 from 53 countries and regions；国家与地区并列时用 and，不能只写 countries。

sentences.cn: 今年有25部中国作品通过这一平台走向海外，国际文化影响力进一步增强。
sentences.ref: This year, 25 Chinese productions traveled abroad through this platform, and the international influence of Chinese culture has grown even stronger.

hints.struct: 时间状语 + 主语 + 过去时 + and + 现在完成时

pts.t: 走向海外 用 traveled abroad；abroad 是副词，不能写成 go to overseas。
中国作品 在文艺语境译 Chinese productions；单复数看前面的 25，用复数。
影响力进一步增强 用 has grown even stronger；「进一步」用 even 或 further 修饰比较级。
前半句是已完成的事实，用一般过去时；后半句讲「（至今）更强」，用现在完成时，时态层次是采分点。

sentences.cn: 该平台还启动全球培训项目，为沿线国家培养表演艺术人才。
sentences.ref: The platform has also launched a global training program to develop performing arts talent for partner countries.

hints.struct: 主语 + has launched + 不定式表目的

pts.t: 还启动 用现在完成时 has also launched；also 放在助动词之后。
培养……人才 用 to develop performing arts talent；talent 作「人才」通常不可数，不要写成 talents。
「为……培养……」用不定式表目的 to develop ... for partner countries；「沿线国家」译 partner countries 更贴合作语境的表达。

sentences.cn: 未来，随着更多合作协定签署，国际文化交流将搭建更畅通的文明桥梁。
sentences.ref: In the future, as more cooperation agreements are signed, international cultural exchange will build a smoother bridge between civilizations.

hints.struct: In the future + as 引导从句 + 主句

pts.t: 随着…… 用 as more ... are signed；as 引导时间状语从句，从句用被动语态。
签署 用 are signed；协定是「被签署」，所以用过去分词。
搭建更畅通的文明桥梁 用 build a smoother bridge between civilizations；bridge between A and B 是固定搭配。

exprs.note: 专有名词，各词首字母大写。

exprs.en: events taking place across the city
exprs.note: across the city 表示全城范围。
since + 过去时间点，主句用完成时。
keep doing 表示持续不断。
launch 启动项目；过去式配完成时。
as 引导时间状语从句。

exprs.cn: 搭建更畅通的文明桥梁

translation.classroomNote: 课堂速练用的两句（2 句模式默认出这两句；5 句全练出全部）
